description: Patch schema for FLUX Kontext relighting through local ComfyUI and a pinned Relight LoRA.

unmapped_ui_parameters.prompt: The plugin combines the visible prompt, illumination style, light direction, and subject-preservation instruction into kontext_relight_prompt before patching node 6.
unmapped_ui_parameters.illumination_style: Mapped in the plugin prompt builder to a natural-language relight instruction using the existing ILLUMINATION_OPTIONS table.
unmapped_ui_parameters.light_direction: Mapped in the plugin prompt builder to a natural-language direction phrase when not set to auto.
unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The existing image-plugin frame control is preserved by the surrounding UI but this workflow emits one PNG per generate call.
unmapped_ui_parameters.negative_prompt: FLUX Kontext's official reference graph derives negative conditioning by zeroing the positive prompt conditioning with ConditioningZeroOut.
